summary: Tidebreak's screens over the ring (RoundScreen after each round, MatchScreen at the match's end), the loading screen's tips on the way into the ring, Quick match's line, and the practice dummy (RingMode's practice: a dummy of a chosen element that stands, blocks or throws; no timer, no rounds; R puts both back at their ends). Plain words only, none from any show (tests/ring/test_player_words.gd reads every string here). The owner, 2026-10-05: 'games not bad', 'it is fun'; catching a stone just before it hits and firing it back is the fun core, so practice is for trying moves and catching.

practice._doc: RingMode's practice (MatchSetup.kind practice; the user arg practice=stand|block|throw). The dummy is a bot of the chosen element held at its end: 'stand' never casts; 'block' answers what comes at it with its element's guard (round 2: the Catch, the Turn, the Parry, the Wind Guard; no dice, every time its lock fits) and raises its cover when you begin a lock (its wall key's first move: MatchSetup.practice_move, this table only when the kit has none; at most every block_every_s); 'throw' casts its throw at you every throw_every_s (its element's strike, round 2: earth a stone spike to catch and send back, water a lash, fire a punch, air a slice, each for its own guard). No timer, no rounds, the soft walls off (walk anywhere); a fall into the water puts both back at their ends after reset_after_out_s; R (ring_reset) puts them back at once, B (ring_dummy) steps the dummy's way. Spent at 0 health: whole again at once.

ways.block: blocks: its guards and its cover
ways.throw: throws at you every few seconds

words.hint: Practice  ·  a %s dummy that %s  ·  R: reset positions  ·  B: stand, block or throw  ·  Esc: menu
words.out: Into the water: back to your ends

tips: The Kick runs along the floor: jump it.
Catch just before it hits: your throw back is faster.
A hit on the beat is yours.
Hold until the circle is full, then let go; let go early and nothing is spent.
Water douses fire, fire melts ice, air drops stone.
Hold 2 longer: a second click, and it grows.
A hit knocks your lock back; it never wipes it. Your dash and your guard always go.
Rising under you? Step off as it starts.
Every return of a caught stone flies faster.
Q puts your readied move on left click; hold Q to have your jab back.
Practice from the main menu: a dummy that stands, blocks or throws, no timer.
tips_classic: Knock the other side back through its three zones and off the open end into the water to take the round.
Pushed back over a line, you are held to that zone for the rest of the round.
You may step into their half only once all of them are pushed back.
At the bell, the side holding more ground takes the round; on level ground, the stronger side.
Spent at nothing, you are not out: you are pushed back a zone and get your breath back.
tips_stock: Three lives each: into the water loses one. The last side with lives left takes the game.
Every hit raises the %. The higher it climbs, the farther the next hit throws.
Thrown off the deck? Jump, jump and jump again: your element lifts you back.
Fall short and you grab the edge: climb up, jump, or roll back in.
At the bell, more lives left takes the game; level, the next one in the water loses.

kit._doc: Round 2 of the skills (the owner, 2026-10-05: 'make the skills easy hard to master ... think human made think avg IQ'): what the player reads about his kit, the same for every element (KitWords: the strip, the wheel, F1, the first-time panels, the element pick, the Controls panels, the lessons). {guard}, {quick}, {aim}, {fire}, {wheel} and {jump} are the keys as bound now. No word from any show.

help.keys: Hold {aim}: aim while it fills, let go to cast  ·  {swap} swaps 1 and 2  ·  let go early: nothing spent
help.first_moves: 1-4 your four moves  ·  hold {aim}: aim while it fills, let go to cast
help.direction: Hold W, S, A or D as you press {aim}: strike, wall or dash  ·  nothing held: the readied move
help.radial: Hold {wheel}: your moves round a wheel, point and let go  ·  hold {aim}: aim, let go to cast

kit._help_strip: round 4 (HUD): the strip's one help line per scheme, ONE line of 64 characters or fewer with the keys as bound (KitWords.strip_help; the first letter made a capital); shown in the first match and in Practice until 20 casts

help_strip.keys: {aim}: hold to aim, let go to cast
help_strip.first_moves: 1-4 your moves  ·  {aim}: hold to aim, let go to cast
help_strip.direction: Hold W, A, S or D with {aim}: strike, dash or wall
help_strip.radial: Hold {wheel} for the wheel  ·  {aim}: hold, let go to cast

rules.lock: Hold: aim while it fills, let go to cast; let go early to call it off. Hold 2 longer: ▲ it grows.
rules.guard: {guard}: on the beat it's yours. Late, half gets through. Earth always catches stone.
rules.web: Water douses fire, fire melts ice, air drops stone.
rules.dodge: Attack while jumping. Walls and healing need ground. Jump over low fire; dash or guard high shots. Step off rising ground.

earth.name: Rooted
earth.line: stand still and your locks fill faster, and you are pushed less.

water.name: Flowing
water.line: your water curves toward where you look for a moment after it leaves.

fire.name: Footwork
fire.line: your locks fill at full speed while you move.

air.name: Carried wind
air.line: hit straight out of a dash and you knock harder.

guards.earth: {guard} catches stones; {guard} again throws them back.
guards.water: {guard} on the beat swings their water round you and sends it back; their Air Lance comes back as ice.
guards.fire: {guard} on the beat sends fire straight back: the only answer to lightning.
guards.air: {guard} on the beat bounces their wind back and drops a stone at your feet.

kit.controls_line: your buttons, the rules of the deck, and other ways to pick moves
kit.other_ways_line: the keys, as above; press for first moves only, direction or the wheel

loading._doc: The ring's loading screen: a current arena screenshot (assets/ui/tidebreak/SOURCE.md) and a caption drawn by lot. No word from any show.
loading.title: Tidebreak
captions: Build pressure with each hit. Higher pressure makes the next launch stronger.
A fall into the water costs a life. Jump, dodge and rise to get back onto the deck.
The crowd fills the stands before the gong.
Stone, water, fire and wind: one ring, one rule. Stay on the deck.

strip_stock._doc: Your own strip in the % ring (BendStrip, rule set stock): while you are in the air key 2 shows your Slam's name, key 3 'Dodge', ground-dependent spells grey with 'lands' using SwayCaster.needs_ground; Fire Breath remains usable on the wall key. Key 3 is never lit as readied (it acts at once); your move names dim a shade at 2, 4 and 6 stale copies (stale_alpha); after a hit on a safe body 'safe' for safe_s on your own strip.
